visuals.title: Figure B1.3.1 Number of Low-, Middle-, and High-Income Countries Covered in International Debt Report 2026, by FY27 Income and Lending Groups
visuals.description: Stacked bar chart showing the count of low-, middle-, and high-income countries across three lending groups: IDA-only countries, Blend countries, and IBRD-only countries. IDA-only countries include 23 low-income, 30 middle-income, and 1 high-income country. Blend countries consist of 19 middle-income countries. IBRD-only countries consist of 47 middle-income countries.
